title: Our Story: A Love Quest
finalMessage: Four years… and I still fall in love with you every single day. ❤

ch1_intro: It was 2020. The world had paused.
Everyone was home. Screens were our only windows to the world outside.
And somewhere in that digital silence… Prawal found her.

ch1_found.speaker: Prawal
ch1_found.text: Our company had organised an online event during the lockdown.

ch1_found.speaker: Prawal
ch1_found.text: Aashna was in one of the photos from the post.

ch1_found.speaker: Prawal
ch1_found.text: Something stopped me. I kept coming back to that photo.

ch1_found.speaker: Prawal
ch1_found.text: There was something about her smile… I couldn't explain it.

ch1_found.speaker: Prawal
ch1_found.text: I didn't even know Aashna's name yet.

ch2_intro.speaker: Prawal
ch2_intro.text: I searched. LinkedIn first. Then Facebook.

ch2_intro.speaker: Prawal
ch2_intro.text: And there she was. Same face. Same smile.

ch2_request.speaker: Prawal
ch2_request.text: I stared at that Add Friend button for longer than I'd like to admit.

ch2_request.speaker: Prawal
ch2_request.text: What if Aashna doesn't accept? What if she thinks it's weird?

ch2_request.speaker: Prawal
ch2_request.text: That one small notification changed the course of everything.

ch3_intro: The messages began — hesitant, then warm.

ch3_chat.speaker: Prawal
ch3_chat.text: We started talking. Small things at first.

ch3_chat.speaker: Aashna
ch3_chat.text: How's work? How's the lockdown treating you?

ch3_chat.speaker: Prawal
ch3_chat.text: And then life happened. The conversations faded.

ch3_chat.speaker: Prawal
ch3_chat.text: But I thought about Aashna more than I should have.

ch3_chat.speaker: Prawal
ch3_chat.text: Some stories aren't done yet. They just… pause.

ch5_intro: Months had passed. Lockdown restrictions were slowly easing.
The office reopened — partially. Rosters. Limited strength.
Prawal walked in that morning not expecting anything special.

ch5_meet.speaker: Prawal
ch5_meet.text: Not a photo. Not a screen.

ch5_meet.speaker: Prawal
ch5_meet.text: Standing there in that maroon hoodie.

ch5_meet.speaker: Prawal
ch5_meet.text: I think my heart forgot how to beat for a second.

ch5_meet.speaker: Prawal
ch5_meet.text: She was even more beautiful in person.

ch5_meet.speaker: Prawal
ch5_meet.text: I didn't say much that day. I didn't need to.

ch5_meet.speaker: Prawal
ch5_meet.text: Some moments just need to be felt.

ch6_intro: Back at the office. The same desks, the same screens.
But something had changed. Prawal found reasons to be near her.
Walk over — she could use some help.

ch6_help.speaker: Prawal
ch6_help.text: After that office day, something shifted.

ch6_help.speaker: Prawal
ch6_help.text: We started talking again. Properly this time.

ch6_help.speaker: Prawal
ch6_help.text: Little chats. A question here. A favour there.

ch6_help.speaker: Aashna
ch6_help.text: Hey, can you help me with something at work?

ch6_help.speaker: Prawal
ch6_help.text: I jumped at every chance — not just to help…

ch6_help.speaker: Prawal
ch6_help.text: But just to have a reason to talk to Aashna.

ch6_help.speaker: Prawal
ch6_help.text: Every small moment with her felt like something worth holding onto.

ch6_gift.speaker: Prawal
ch6_gift.text: I wanted to do something nice. Something unexpected.

ch6_gift.speaker: Prawal
ch6_gift.text: So I got Aashna wireless earphones. A surprise.

ch6_gift.speaker: Aashna
ch6_gift.text: Oh my god — I love them! Thank you so much!

ch6_gift.speaker: Prawal
ch6_gift.text: And then… she forgot them at the office.

ch6_gift.speaker: Aashna
ch6_gift.text: I remembered when I got home. I called, I tried — they were just gone.

ch6_gift.speaker: Prawal
ch6_gift.text: I saw how sad she was. And made up my mind instantly.

ch6_gift.speaker: Prawal
ch6_gift.text: Aashna was going to have that smile back.

ch6_gift.speaker: Prawal
ch6_gift.text: Because some smiles are worth every penny. Twice over.

ch7_intro: The evening sun was warm. The world felt lighter.
Prawal had something for Aashna. Something small, but meaningful.
Find the gift in the park.

ch7_pizza.speaker: Prawal
ch7_pizza.text: The day I gave Aashna the second pair of earphones…

ch7_pizza.speaker: Prawal
ch7_pizza.text: We decided to go out after office. Just like that.

ch7_pizza.speaker: Prawal
ch7_pizza.text: A small pizza place. Nothing fancy.

ch7_pizza.speaker: Prawal
ch7_pizza.text: But it was our first time outside together.

ch7_pizza.speaker: Aashna
ch7_pizza.text: This is really nice… we should do this more often.

ch7_pizza.speaker: Prawal
ch7_pizza.text: Something about that evening just… felt right.

ch7_pizza.speaker: Prawal
ch7_pizza.text: Like we'd always been doing this.

ch8_intro: A pizza place near the metro, just outside the office.
They'd decided that afternoon — just the two of them and a friend.
Walk to the table — she's already waiting.

ch8_growth.speaker: Prawal
ch8_growth.text: After that evening… things were different.

ch8_growth.speaker: Prawal
ch8_growth.text: Messages came easier. Silences felt comfortable.

ch8_growth.speaker: Prawal
ch8_growth.text: We stopped pretending it was just friendship.

ch8_growth.speaker: Prawal
ch8_growth.text: Something was quietly, beautifully growing between Prawal and Aashna.

ch8_growth.speaker: Prawal
ch8_growth.text: And for the first time… I wasn't afraid of it.

ch9_intro: Somewhere between the long calls and the quiet mornings…
It wasn't sudden. It was slow, and warm, and real.
Walk through the memories of how Prawal and Aashna grew closer.
letters_intro: 2021. The world was still finding its feet.
And every single morning — before the day began — Prawal sent a message to Aashna.
The same ritual. Every day. Without fail.

letter_morning_1.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_1.text: I woke up thinking of you — like I do every morning now.

letter_morning_1.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_1.text: I had to tell you that.

letter_morning_1.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_1.text: I don't know what this feeling is yet.

letter_morning_1.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_1.text: But it felt too important to keep to myself.

letter_morning_2.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_2.text: I saw something funny today and thought — she'd laugh at this.

letter_morning_2.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_2.text: So I sent it to you immediately.

letter_morning_2.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_2.text: Sharing little things with you feels like the most natural thing.

letter_morning_3.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_3.text: Some mornings I message you just to say I'm thinking of you.

letter_morning_3.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_3.text: That feeling — warm and steady — it belongs to you.

letter_morning_4.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_4.text: But I haven't missed a single morning.

letter_morning_4.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_4.text: I think you know why by now.

letter_morning_5.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_5.text: Every morning — before the world woke up — this message went to you first.

letter_morning_5.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_5.text: Each one sent. Each one meant.

letter_morning_5.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_5.text: By the time this one reached you, Aashna…

letter_morning_5.speaker: Prawal
letter_morning_5.text: You already had my heart. Completely.

ch10_intro: There were silences. Misunderstandings. Words said too fast.
Walk forward. The way back to each other is always there.

ch9_fight.text: Not everything was smooth. Love never is.

ch9_fight.speaker: Prawal
ch9_fight.text: We had our arguments. Our silences. Our misunderstandings.

ch9_fight.speaker: Aashna
ch9_fight.text: Sometimes I didn't know how to say what I was feeling.

ch9_fight.speaker: Prawal
ch9_fight.text: Words said in the heat of a moment.

ch9_fight.speaker: Prawal
ch9_fight.text: But every single time… Prawal and Aashna came back.

ch9_fight.speaker: Prawal
ch9_fight.text: A little more patient. A little more understanding.

ch9_fight.speaker: Prawal
ch9_fight.text: Every storm made us stronger. That's how we knew it was real.

gifts_intro: They say love is in the big moments.
But Prawal knows it's in the small ones.
The ordinary evening when you order her favourite food — from your home, to hers.
The little things, sent with intention.
Explore the room — there are surprises to find here.

gift_food.speaker: Prawal
gift_food.text: Sometimes, after a fight — or even without reason —

gift_food.speaker: Prawal
gift_food.text: I'd order Aashna's favourite food. Delivered to her door.

gift_food.speaker: Prawal
gift_food.text: Just: here. Eat. I'm thinking of you.

gift_food.speaker: Prawal
gift_food.text: Food says 'I love you' in every language.

gift_delivery_sorry.text: One time, after a disagreement between Prawal and Aashna…

gift_delivery_sorry.speaker: Prawal
gift_delivery_sorry.text: I didn't know what to say.

gift_delivery_sorry.speaker: Prawal
gift_delivery_sorry.text: So I messaged the delivery partner before the drop.

gift_delivery_sorry.speaker: Prawal
gift_delivery_sorry.text: 'Can you please tell her I'm sorry from my side?'
He did. He actually said it.

gift_delivery_sorry.speaker: Prawal
gift_delivery_sorry.text: That delivery guy will never know what he helped fix that evening.

gift_lovebook.speaker: Prawal
gift_lovebook.text: I had a book made. Our story — illustrated, printed, bound.

gift_lovebook.speaker: Prawal
gift_lovebook.text: Every chapter of Prawal & Aashna, held in your hands.

gift_lovebook.speaker: Prawal
gift_lovebook.text: That silence was the best review I ever got.

gift_photos.speaker: Prawal
gift_photos.text: We had so many photos. Scattered across phones and drives.

gift_photos.speaker: Prawal
gift_photos.text: So I had them printed. Framed. Displayed.

gift_photos.speaker: Prawal
gift_photos.text: The laughing ones. The quiet ones. The blurry ones.

gift_photos.speaker: Aashna
gift_photos.text: Why did you print the blurry ones too?

gift_photos.speaker: Prawal
gift_photos.text: Especially the blurry ones. Those are the real ones.

gift_cup.speaker: Prawal
gift_cup.text: A simple mug. Made just for Aashna.

gift_cup.speaker: Prawal
gift_cup.text: Her name. Her photo. That's all it needed.

gift_cup.speaker: Prawal
gift_cup.text: Every morning when she makes her tea…

gift_cup.speaker: Aashna
gift_cup.text: I use it every single day, you know.

ch12_intro: A home. Warm and full of voices.
Letters from those who love Prawal and Aashna most.
Walk around. Find the blessings they left behind.

ch11_family.text: The time came to take the next step.
To bring our two worlds together.
To let the people who shaped Prawal and Aashna… meet each other.

ch11_family.speaker: Prawal
ch11_family.text: I remember how nervous I was that day.
But the moment our families met…
Like they'd always known each other.
Like this was always meant to be.

ch12_letter_1.text: 'I always knew you'd find someone who sees you the way I do.'
'Take care of each other. That's all I ask.'

ch12_letter_2.text: 'I'm proud of the person you've become.'
'And I'm proud of who you chose to walk beside.'

ch12_letter_3.text: A scribbled note from a sister.
'You two are disgustingly cute. Don't ever change. 😂'
'But seriously… I've never seen you happier.'

ch12_letter_4.text: A letter written together. By both families.
'We didn't lose a child. We gained one.'
'This family just got bigger. And better.'

ch12_family.text: Every letter said the same thing in a different way.
'You are loved. You are seen. You belong here.'

ch12_family.speaker: Prawal
ch12_family.text: I didn't know what to expect that day.

ch12_family.speaker: Prawal
ch12_family.text: But when both families sat down together…
Just warmth. Just laughter. Just home.

ch12_family.speaker: Prawal
ch12_family.text: And mine already loved you too.
Two families. One story. And it was just beginning.

ch13_intro: Two lives. Two journeys. Two different stories.
But somewhere along the way… the paths began to bend.
Walk forward. She's waiting where the roads meet.

ch13_reunion.speaker: Prawal
ch13_reunion.text: Every step I took… led me closer to her.

ch13_reunion.speaker: Prawal
ch13_reunion.text: Through distance, through doubt, through time.

ch13_reunion.speaker: Aashna
ch13_reunion.text: It was always going to be you.
Some paths are meant to merge.

ch14_intro: Flowers on each side. Lights above.

ch14_wedding.text: A circle of gold. A promise made.
The flowers. The laughter. The tears of joy.

ch14_wedding.speaker: Prawal
ch14_wedding.text: I looked at Aashna in that moment…

ch14_wedding.speaker: Prawal
ch14_wedding.text: And I thought — this is the best day of my life.

ch14_wedding.speaker: Prawal
ch14_wedding.text: This is the beginning of everything.

ch15_intro: No rooms. No objects. No noise.
Just two people standing in the middle of everything they've built.

ch15_finale.speaker: Prawal
ch15_finale.text: Four years of mornings and midnights.

ch15_finale.speaker: Prawal
ch15_finale.text: Of laughter that echoes and silences that comfort.

ch15_finale.speaker: Prawal
ch15_finale.text: Four years of choosing each other.

ch15_finale.speaker: Prawal
ch15_finale.text: And I fall in love with you a little more… every single day.
